recommendation_summary: Acts now with a same-day manual fix: one person reviews today's orders, sorts unfinished cakes by pickup time, assigns bakers and tracks progress. It then lays out a present Odoo rollout: agree preparation rules, pilot linked sales, manufacturing and ingredient flows with a shared counter view, test missed-pickup cases, then expand, migrate and cut over. It frames the core problem as preparation not following pickup dates, but it does not reject the ERP or sync proposal. Unmet need: it endorses the larger stack now instead of keeping to the bounded due-today view.
note: The reply correctly spots the scheduling bottleneck, but it recommends structuring the Odoo rollout now and has none of the four record labels.
